newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO DRAW GIVES BARCELONA BREATHING SPACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO DRAW GIVES BARCELONA BREATHING SPACE.

text.p: Barcelona were left with a five-point cushion in their bid to take Spain's second European Cup place after rivals Deportivo Coruna drew 1-1 at Valencia on Monday.
Barcelona, in turn five points behind leaders Real Madrid after Saturday's 1-0 victory over the league leaders, must play third-placed Deportivo in one of their five remaining league games.
Barcelona also face Real Betis, fourth and one point behind Deportivo, after losing 2-1 to Logrones on Sunday.
Brazilian striker Renaldo opened the scoring for Deportivo in the 17th minute after picking up a rebound when compatriot Rivaldo saw his shot stopped by Valencia keeper Andoni Zubizarreta.
Ariel Ortega levelled from the penalty spot on the half-hour when another Brazilian, Leandro, was felled in the area by Deportivo defender Paco Gemez.
Valencia hung on in the last 25 minutes despite having Javi Navarro sent off for a second yellow card offence.
